cause.description: Typed reason the previous process stopped: a vendor limit (next account eligible), the whole pool spent, a pinned account's limit, an error without a typed cause (`transport`: a crash, an inactivity timeout or a harness-reported error; not proof that a process died or the network failed), a confirmed native tool permission refusal, context exhaustion, the run's max-turns cap, the wall-clock deadline, a cancel, a daemon/host restart, a model that asked for input, or another typed cause.

resetsAt.description: When the spent vendor window reopens, only from a vendor signal; never fabricated.

limitWindow.description: The vendor's own name for the spent window (e.g. five_hour, seven_day_opus), when known.

anyOf.description: window: the vendor named the spent window (a reset instant or a constraint id); unspecified: a typed limit without a window — a bare backoff frame is transport, not a limit.

limitEvidence.description: window: the vendor named the spent window (a reset instant or a constraint id); unspecified: a typed limit without a window — a bare backoff frame is transport, not a limit.

items.description: A continuity representation still available for a stopped run.

carriers.description: Continuity representations still available (NOT quota readiness; readiness is described by the limit facts).

limitCode.description: The typed vendor limit code that ended the work, when any.

session.description: The native session a continuation can resume, when one exists.

workspace.description: Where the stopped work's tree is: the live root, a retained envelope, or gone.

RunResumable.description: Terminal facts of a stopped run that can be continued: cause, limit evidence, available carriers, the native session and the workspace.
